# `fs` — `/api/fs`

File system exploration API — lets the agent and UI browse and read local files. All paths are resolved relative to the project root and sandboxed there.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/fs/browse-home`](#get-api-fs-browse-home) | List subdirectories of a folder in the user's home (for the save dialog). |
| GET | [`/api/fs/ls`](#get-api-fs-ls) | List immediate children of a directory with type + size. |
| POST | [`/api/fs/mkdir`](#post-api-fs-mkdir) | Create a new subfolder inside a home-directory folder (save dialog). |
| GET | [`/api/fs/read`](#get-api-fs-read) | Return the text content of a file (max 256 KB). |
| POST | [`/api/fs/save-audio`](#post-api-fs-save-audio) | Save a base64 audio clip into a folder in the user's home. |
| POST | [`/api/fs/save-image`](#post-api-fs-save-image) | Save a base64 image into a folder in the user's home. |
| GET | [`/api/fs/tree`](#get-api-fs-tree) | Return a JSON directory tree up to `depth` levels deep. |

<a id="get-api-fs-browse-home"></a>
### `GET /api/fs/browse-home`

List subdirectories of a folder in the user's home (for the save dialog).

- Handler: [`fs_browse_home`](../../../backend/routers/fs.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | query | string | no | `"~"` | Absolute path or ~ inside home |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `path`, `parent`, `home`, `dirs`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 403 | Path outside home directory | `_home_path` |
| 403 | Permission denied | `fs_browse_home` |
| 404 | Not a directory: {path} | `fs_browse_home` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="get-api-fs-ls"></a>
### `GET /api/fs/ls`

List immediate children of a directory with type + size.

- Handler: [`fs_ls`](../../../backend/routers/fs.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | query | string | no | `"."` | Relative path from project root |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `path`, `entries` (empty JSON list)

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Not a directory | `fs_ls` |
| 403 | Path outside project root | `_safe_path` |
| 403 | Sensitive application or credential files are not available through project tools | `_safe_path` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 501 | Project file browsing isn't available in a packaged build — there's no source checkout to browse. Run from source for this feature; see docs/troubleshooting.md. | `_safe_path` |

<a id="post-api-fs-save-audio"></a>
### `POST /api/fs/save-audio`

Save a base64 audio clip into a folder in the user's home. Auto-renames on conflict.

- Handler: [`fs_save_audio`](../../../backend/routers/fs.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `SaveAudioBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | string | yes |  |  |
| `filename` | string | yes |  |  |
| `data` | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `saved`, `bytes`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Empty audio data | `fs_save_audio` |
| 400 | Filename must be a plain name ending in .wav/.mp3/.ogg/.flac | `fs_save_audio` |
| 400 | Invalid base64 audio data | `fs_save_audio` |
| 403 | Path outside home directory | `_home_path` |
| 413 | Audio too large (max 300 MB) | `fs_save_audio` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 500 | Could not write file: {e} | `fs_save_audio` |
